atAGlance: Đậu hũ sốt cà chua is tofu in tomato sauce, usually with fried tofu, tomato gravy, scallion, and rice.
whatItIs: Đậu hũ sốt cà chua is fried tofu simmered in tomato gravy with scallions, garlic, and light seasoning. It is soft, tangy, and made for rice.
howToEnjoy: Spoon the tomato gravy over rice and eat while the tofu edges are still slightly firm. Ask about fish sauce if you need strict vegetarian seasoning.
howLocalsOrder: Order đậu hũ sốt cà chua for a gentle tofu rice dish. Say không nước mắm if the tomato gravy needs to be fully vegetarian.
worthKnowing: This is homestyle Vietnamese comfort food: simple tofu, bright tomato, and rice doing quiet work together.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the tomato sauce uses fish sauce or meat stock at mixed family-style restaurants.
travelerCaution: Confirm the tomato sauce is vegetarian if strict.
